What we found

3 things are costing you bookings.

  • Book Now is a contact formEvery Book Now button opens the general Contact page, with no time to pick.
  • No Book button on phonesThe first phone screen shows two call buttons and a cookie banner, no way to book.
  • The form skips what she wantsIt asks for a country code and 1 of 10 service categories, not her goal.
